scenario_title: Scenario 1: Answer Cites an Expired Policy
expected_ground_truth_outcome: Cite active policy POL-IT-2026-002 (v2.0, effective 2026-05-01) and active article KB-000032 (v2.0).
actual_operational_record_observed: Cited expired policy POL-IT-2026-001 (v1.0, expired 2026-04-30) on ticket submitted 2026-09-03.
actual_system_remediation_outcome: Retrieval engine excluded expired POL-IT-2026-001 v1.0 and selected active superseding policy POL-IT-2026-002 v2.0 (effective 2026-05-01).

scenario_title: Scenario 2: Ticket Routed to an Unauthorized Team
expected_ground_truth_outcome: Route 'IT' ticket to 'Campus IT Operations & Identity Desk' under rule 'RULE-IT-001'.
actual_operational_record_observed: Routed 'IT' ticket to unauthorized team 'Office of Financial Aid & Scholarships' under rule 'RULE-FINAID-001'.
actual_system_remediation_outcome: validateTicketAssignmentAndRouting() rejected unauthorized team 'Office of Financial Aid & Scholarships' and evaluateTicketRouting() assigned 'Campus IT Operations & Identity Desk' under 'RULE-IT-001'.

scenario_title: Scenario 3: Response Claims an Unsupported Fact
expected_ground_truth_outcome: Restrict response strictly to facts stated in POL-IT-2026-002 v2.0 (Section 1.2 (Current)).
actual_operational_record_observed: Response MSG-TKT-2026-000011-003 asserted an unverified '$5,000 cash grant and 45-day deadline waiver' absent from POL-IT-2026-002.
actual_system_remediation_outcome: RAG grounding verifier flagged unsupported factual claim (Monetary fees, fines, dollar amounts, or cash reimbursements are not established in the retrieved active policy documents.) and blocked ungrounded assertion, recommending human escalation.

scenario_title: Scenario 4: SLA Clock Ignores Business Hours
expected_ground_truth_outcome: Compute elapsed_business_minutes=180m under SCHED-CONFIG-MON-FRI-0800-1700-UTC vs target=240m -> breach_status=false.
actual_operational_record_observed: Computed breach_status=true using raw 24x7 wall-clock elapsed=3960m across weekend non-working hours.
actual_system_remediation_outcome: Business-hour SLA calculator excluded weekend non-working hours (Fri 15:30 -> Mon 09:30 UTC), computing elapsed_business_minutes=180m vs target=240m -> breach_status=false.

expected_ground_truth_outcome: Transition ticket TKT-2026-000019 to 'escalated' and assign to 'Information Security & Infrastructure Escalation Unit'.
actual_operational_record_observed: Ticket TKT-2026-000019 remained assigned to 'Campus IT Operations & Identity Desk' and transitioned directly to 'resolved' without escalation.
actual_system_remediation_outcome: Escalation engine detected mandatory trigger 'human_review_required' and recommended transition to 'escalated' assigned to 'Information Security & Infrastructure Escalation Unit'.
